role: Independent evidence-engineering reviewer; tests and report only, no production edits
purpose: Assess the complete fixed finite-grid development study, exact outer uncertainty, durable reservation/settlement accounting and retained generation/bootstrap/MC/replay integration against research-contract/1.0 sections 5.3, 5.4 and 11.
conclusion: No remaining substantiated defect found in the bounded review after the documented fixes. The reviewed implementation can retain an uncalibrated development study and nominate a smallest tested target only after its complete declared grid. These checks do not establish adequate real-market nuisance assumptions, calibrated power, scientific N_min or admission.
reviewed_sources: Existing population, evaluation-plan, bootstrap/MC, storage, memory and broker ownership boundaries

independence.fixed_oracles: Closed-form CP endpoints, nonmonotone and nondirectional selection counts, and a reservation ledger were communicated before reading the new pure implementation. Expectations were not changed to fit the implementation.
independence.retry_scope_clarification: The initial informal max_attempts example did not identify global versus per-world scope. The stable API explicitly assigns the cap per world; tests check that scope and keep next_reservation_fits an aggregate resource predicate.
independence.reused_setup: The owner tests reuse the existing owned plan/execution/diagnostic fixture setup without importing or inheriting its test methods.
independence.fault_fixture_limits: Pipeline status mapping and dispatcher routing use explicit mocked fault fixtures. Mock proofs are not replay evidence. The consistently rehashed stream attack separately runs real generation and a real fresh replay child.

hand_expectations.exact_dyadic_root: For n=1,k=0,noncoverage=1/2, the upper root is exactly 3/4 and has a zero-width bracket.
hand_expectations.finite_enumeration: All n=1..8 and p=j/16 for j=0..16 have exact enumerated coverage at least 19/20 with outward 8-bit endpoints; reflected bounds and maximum bracket width are checked.
hand_expectations.contract_count_distinction: Separate one-sided 95% endpoints correspond to a two-sided 90% interval. At n=256, upper<=0.10 admits at most17 errors; lower>=0.70 requires192 detections. The point estimate>=0.80 requires205 detections (52 of64). These are arithmetic fixtures, not calibration observations.
hand_expectations.nonmonotone_grid: At targets8,12,16 with5 worlds/cell and2delta detections4,3,5, nominate8 only after the complete grid.
hand_expectations.nondirectional_grid: Positive counts4,4,5 and negative counts3,4,5 nominate12; one required stress/sign falling below4/5 moves the candidate to16, and a further required failure removes the candidate.
hand_expectations.denominators: Four detections plus one completed information gap is4/5; replacing that gap with a technical failure or model gap makes the study incomplete.
hand_expectations.accounting: With aggregate1000ms/1000bytes and per-attempt400ms/300bytes, known125/90 then unknown0/0 then known100/50 charge625ms/440bytes. All three attempts remain charged; a fourth attempt for that world is rejected.

owner_evidence: Known technical retries preserve the identical world and seeds; both failed artifacts, prefixes and charges remain; retry cap and key alias cannot reset that exact study.
An already settled attempt cannot append another settlement.
A staging failure leaves an outstanding reservation; the normal advance is fenced, recovery charges the full reservation, and repeated recovery does not restart or refund it.
Unknown materialization metadata is conservatively charged rather than refunded.
Completed information gaps advance to the next fixed world; resource/time/segment/numeric stops map to technical failure.
Completed MC instability becomes inconclusive and interval coverage is evaluated against population truth, not the realized sample contrast.

A coherently rehashed changed generation stream passes superficial digest consistency but is rejected by real separate-process replay; the study retains technical failure and both streams/errors without nomination.
qualifications: Outer intervals use exact tail comparisons and outward dyadic root brackets. They are pointwise under fixed independent outer worlds in the declared simulation law, not simultaneous or selection-adjusted confidence guarantees.
At zero and delta the summary reports detection rates; planned power is identified at2delta. A point80% crossing is not proof that true power exceeds80%.

The owned ledger enforces each immutable study budget, not a global machine/campaign budget across independently prepared profiles. A new version or continuation still needs its recorded resource/exposure disposition.

Storage accounting is declared logical materializations plus retained outputs and a fixed metadata allowance, not an OS disk or memory quota. Measured compute covers parent elapsed work through staging and explicitly excludes final commit.
The retained cost source is operator input with development-only ancestry, explicitly not an authenticated benchmark.
Orphan recovery is tested by invoking the actual recovery path with outstanding reservations; no real process-tree crash or OS disk exhaustion was induced.
Parent full regression and forthcoming HTTP engineering probes are separate evidence and are not claimed as reviewer-executed checks.
preservation: All47 captured files remained byte-identical during the final owned test run. Earlier planning assessment, frozen diagnostic fixtures and prior review/verification reports were not edited. Earlier failed checks retain their own source snapshots.
unverified_boundaries: Real-market population-model adequacy, fitted dependence and nuisance uncertainty
Attainable real-workload power/precision grid or scientific N_min
Fresh256-dataset narrow calibration, boundary/mixed-family calibration and full-process calibration
Original H_exec/raw-market replay, scientific admission/freeze, economic benefit or capital authority
next_action: Use the parent retained regression and genuine HTTP engineering probe to check deployment wiring. An actual information study must still finish its predeclared feasible grid and retain all resource/technical outcomes; later scientific admission requires the outstanding adequacy, calibration and freeze gates.
